novel_features.name: Fleet cockpit
novel_features.description: One-glance board across all your apps: review state, latest build + processing state, and an action-needed flag.
novel_features.rationale: Requires fanning every app across the apps, builds, versions, and reviews endpoints and folding them into one row per app — no single API call returns it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer 'what across all my apps needs attention right now' in one call instead of N per-app lookups.

novel_features.name: In-flight review board with SLA aging
novel_features.description: Every version currently in the review pipeline across all apps, ranked by how long it has been waiting.
novel_features.rationale: Requires ordering appStoreVersions across apps by createdDate age — no tool ages review-state across a fleet.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to catch a submission that has been stuck in WAITING_FOR_REVIEW or IN_REVIEW too long.

novel_features.name: Traction leaderboard
novel_features.description: Ranks your apps by recent rating and review volume and flags apps whose rating is trending down; adds download counts when ASC_VENDOR_NUMBER is set.
novel_features.rationale: Requires computing a per-app rating trend across every app's review stream and ranking the fleet — pofky's daily_briefing only summarizes one app.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to decide which app is actually gaining traction and which one's rating is slipping.

novel_features.name: Fleet feedback pulse
novel_features.description: Newest written customer reviews across all your apps in one merged stream.
novel_features.rationale: Requires merging per-app review streams sorted by createdDate — the API only exposes reviews one app at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for a daily feedback read across the whole portfolio without querying each app.

novel_features.name: Action-needed blockers
novel_features.description: Correlates failed/invalid builds, pending or absent submissions, and metadata rejections into one fleet blocker list.
novel_features.rationale: Requires correlating build processingState, submission state, and appStoreState across every app — no endpoint returns 'what is blocked'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to find every app that cannot ship right now and why, in one call.

narrative.headline: A read-only App Store Connect cockpit that shows every app you ship at once — review state, builds, downloads, and ratings in one glance.
narrative.value_prop: Every existing App Store Connect tool is single-app and CI-shaped. asc is the opposite: a fleet-wide read cockpit for a developer shipping many apps. cockpit rolls up review state and action-needed flags across all apps, pipeline ages in-flight submissions, traction ranks downloads and rating trend, and blockers lists everything that can't ship right now.
narrative.auth_narrative: Uses an App Store Connect API key (JWT ES256). Create a key under Users and Access > Integrations, download the .p8, and set ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, and ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH. Keys are scoped to one team; run one team per invocation.

quickstart.comment: confirm the API key is valid and the API is reachable
the one-glance board across every app you ship
list all apps in the team as structured JSON
what is in review right now and how long it has waited
newest written reviews across the fleet

troubleshoots.fix: Token expired (max life 20 min) or wrong issuer/key id — re-check ASC_KEY_ID / ASC_ISSUER_ID / ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.
Set ASC_VENDOR_NUMBER (found in App Store Connect > Payments and Financial Reports) — the sales report requires a vendor number.
App Store Connect limits ~3600/hour; asc backs off automatically, but narrow --window or add --limit on large fleets.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for asc when you ship more than one iOS app and want a single read across all of them — review state, in-flight submissions, downloads, and ratings — without opening the App Store Connect web UI app by app. It is read-only: it never edits metadata, submits, or releases.
